timeclocker validation notes

Checked locally with:

    gcc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Iinclude src/timeclocker.c tests/test_timeclocker.c -o build/test_timeclocker
    ./build/test_timeclocker

Result:

    exit code 0

Also checked example_game_loop.c with the same C89 flags.

Library source uses no dynamic allocation, no stdio.h, no float/double, no stdint.h/stdbool.h, no C99 comments, and no inline keyword.
